task: The number of applicants ___ fallen sharply this year. (have)
explanation shown to learner: *The number of* + plural noun takes a singular verb: the number is one thing. *The number of applicants has fallen.*
explanation in Latvian: *The number of* + daudzskaitlis prasa darbības vārdu vienskaitlī: skaitlis ir viena lieta. *The number of applicants has fallen.*

task: A number of applicants ___ already withdrawn. (have)
explanation shown to learner: *A number of* = several, so the verb is plural: *A number of applicants have withdrawn.* Compare: *The number of applicants has fallen* (the number is one thing).
explanation in Latvian: *A number of* = vairāki, tāpēc darbības vārds ir daudzskaitlī (salīdzini: *The number of applicants has fallen*, skaitlis ir viena lieta): *A number of applicants have withdrawn.*

task: The manager, together with two of her assistants, ___ coming to the meeting. (be)
explanation shown to learner: The main noun is *the manager*; a phrase with *together with* does not change the verb: *is coming*.
explanation in Latvian: *Galvenais* lietvārds ir *the manager*; izteiciens ar *together with* darbības vārdu nemaina: *is coming*.

explanation shown to learner: *politics* ends in *-s* but takes a singular verb: *Politics has never interested me.*
explanation in Latvian: *politics* beidzas ar *-s*, bet darbības vārds ir vienskaitlī: *Politics has never interested me.*

task: The criteria for the award ___ changed this year. (have)
explanation shown to learner: *criteria* is the plural of *criterion*: *The criteria have changed.*

task: Ten kilometres ___ a long way to walk in this heat. (be)
explanation shown to learner: An amount seen as one distance takes a singular verb: *Ten kilometres is a long way.*
explanation in Latvian: Daudzums, ko uztver kā vienu attālumu, prasa vienskaitli: *Ten kilometres is a long way.*

correct answer: Each of the rooms have a private bathroom.
wrong options / checks: More than one guest has complained about the noise. | Neither of the answers is correct. | One in four adults has never been abroad.
explanation shown to learner: *each of* + plural noun takes a singular verb: *Each of the rooms has a private bathroom*.
explanation in Latvian: *each of* + daudzskaitlis prasa darbības vārdu vienskaitlī: *Each of the rooms has a private bathroom.*

task: Either the manager or her assistants ___ going to call you back. (be)
explanation shown to learner: After *either … or*, the verb agrees with the nearer noun: *her assistants are*.
explanation in Latvian: Aiz *either* … *or* darbības vārds saskan ar tuvāko lietvārdu: *her assistants are*.

task: Being late for every meeting ___ not going to help your career. (be)
explanation shown to learner: An *-ing* clause as the subject is singular, even if it contains a plural noun: *Being late for every meeting is…*
explanation in Latvian: Darbības vārds ar *-ing* kā teikuma priekšmets ir vienskaitlī, arī ja tajā ir daudzskaitlis: *Being late for every meeting is*…

task: After three days, the jury ___ still arguing among themselves. (be)
explanation shown to learner: The jury as separate people (*among themselves*): plural verb, *are arguing*.
explanation in Latvian: Žūrija kā atsevišķi cilvēki (*among themselves*): darbības vārds daudzskaitlī, *are arguing*.
